newsitem.title: USA: Parker Drilling to buy Hercules Rig, Offshore.
newsitem.headline: Parker Drilling to buy Hercules Rig, Offshore.

text.p: Parker Drilling Co said on Friday it signed definitive agreements to acquire Hercules Offshore Corp and Hercules Rig Corp for $195 million.
Hercules Offshore Corp, a Houston-based offshore drilling contractor, was owned by Trenergy (Malaysia) Bhd.
The companies own seven jackup rigs and three self-erecting platform rigs in the Gulf of Mexico, Parker Drilling said in a statement.
They also own one additional rig on bareboat charter to a firm in Brazil, the company said. All the rigs were under contract with the exception of one unit which was being refurbished, it said.

"This acquisition is consistent with and continues Parker Drilling's overall strategy to acquire leading companies in active, niche offshore markets," Parker President and Chief Executive Robert Parker Jr said.
Parker said closing of the deal was subject to financing and Trenergy obtaining the necessary stockholder and Malaysian securities commission approvals. Other terms of the deal were not released.
